blocks.title: Semisimplification: skew transformations, derivations
blocks.content:
4. Semisimplification: skew transformations, derivations
This section will show some features of the semisimplification process. The Lie algebra
of derivations of an algebra .A; / in Rep C3 is also an algebra in Rep C3 in a natural
way, but its semisimplification may fail to be the Lie superalgebra of derivations of the
semisimplification of .A; /. However, the semisimplification of the Lie algebra of the
skew-symmetric transformations, relative to the norm, of a composition algebra in Rep C3
is isomorphic to the orthosymplectic Lie superalgebra of skew-transformations (in the
super setting)
